value.rationale: The mathematical question is which meaningful two-alternative neutral voting rules preserve the sign of the effect of conformist social influence. The theorem resolves it exactly, uniformly over all finite populations, all positive leader-weight pairs and every self-dual monotone Boolean aggregation rule, without requiring anonymity. It separates the direction of committed influence from rule design and provides a structural likelihood-ratio explanation that a fixed-n simulation cannot supply.
